# PlainLedger

> Financial reporting, industry indicators and planning tools for Canadian businesses. The interface supports French and English.

The public website is https://plainledger.ca/. Product demonstrations can contain illustrative data. Demonstration numbers are not evidence of customer counts, training volume, measured accuracy, reviews or savings. Consult the current product pages for availability and commercial terms.

## Public pages

- [Financial dashboards for Canadian SMBs | PlainLedger](https://plainledger.ca/): PlainLedger brings together financial reports, industry indicators and analysis tools for Canadian businesses.
- [PlainLedger newsletter | PlainLedger](https://plainledger.ca/newsletter): Explore the PlainLedger newsletter about business finance and accounting. Visit the page to subscribe and see the topics covered.
- [Terms of service | PlainLedger](https://plainledger.ca/terms): Read the terms for using the PlainLedger platform, including account, subscription and service conditions.
- [Privacy policy | PlainLedger](https://plainledger.ca/privacy): Read the PlainLedger privacy policy for information about personal information and data protection practices.
- [Security and data protection | PlainLedger](https://plainledger.ca/security): Review PlainLedger’s published information about security, access controls and data protection.
- [PlainLedger for Quebec businesses | PlainLedger](https://plainledger.ca/quebec): Explore the financial planning tools, indicators and tax credit resources presented for Quebec businesses.
- [PlainLedger for Canadian businesses | PlainLedger](https://plainledger.ca/canada): Explore financial reports, accounting connections and planning resources for Canadian businesses. The interface supports French and English.
- [SR&ED tax credit calculator | PlainLedger](https://plainledger.ca/tools/sred-calculator): Use the calculator to explore an estimate of research and development credits. An estimate does not confirm eligibility and must be checked for your situation.
- [PlainLedger for Montreal businesses | PlainLedger](https://plainledger.ca/quebec/montreal): Explore the financial planning resources and industry information presented for Montreal businesses.

## Scope

This file is a navigation aid. It does not establish indexing, ranking, endorsements or certification. Account, administration and shared-document routes are not public reference material.
